title: Pass-through pricing
body: We make money on the platform fee, never on your tokens. The moment we take a cut per token, our incentives point the wrong way.

title: The log is the product
body: Every route decision is written down with its reason. A router you cannot audit is a router you cannot trust with production.

title: Boring on purpose
body: The API is OpenAI-compatible and stays that way. We change what is behind the endpoint, not the endpoint.
